## Just press **Submit new issue** 👇

The title already holds your move, so there's nothing to edit.
A bot places your mark, replies here, and closes the issue.

| Title | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `ttt\|move\|0` … `ttt\|move\|8` | Places the next mark (X or O) on that square, numbered left to right, top to bottom |
| `ttt\|reset` | Clears the board and starts a new game |

X and O take turns and anyone can play either side. Get three in a row to win.
